.. change::
    :tags: orm, deprecation
    :tickets: 11853

    The deprecation emitted when :func:`_orm.joinedload` or
    :func:`_orm.subqueryload` are used as a top level option against a
    statement that is not a SELECT statement, such as with an
    ``insert().returning()``, is now a hard error raising
    :class:`_exc.InvalidRequestError`.  There are no JOINs in INSERT
    statements nor is there a "subquery" that can be repurposed for subquery
    eager loading, and for UPDATE/DELETE joinedload does not support these
    either, so it is never appropriate for this use to pass silently.
